name: Pontos Taverna
notes: Full menu from the official site. Platters come with orzo, tzatziki, pita, tomato and red onion; sandwiches on pita with tzatziki, tomato and red onion. Seafood prices may vary with the market.

sections.name: Salads
items: Country style Greek salad: vine tomatoes, seedless cucumber, red onion, peperoncini, Kalamata olives and Dodoni feta cheese
Fresh cut beet and garlic salad: boiled & chilled beets, garlic and balsamic vinegar
Artisan romaine salad: finely shredded romaine lettuce, dill, red onion, scallion and lemon

sections.name: Cheeses
items: Warmed feta with tomato and hot pepper, served with pita
Spicy mashed feta spread, served with pita

sections.name: À la Carte
items: Baked giant white beans in tomato sauce

sections.name: From the Sea
items: Large shrimp sautéed with tomato feta sauce

items: Slow roast pork gyro off the spit
Greek seasoned beef patty stuffed with saganaki cheese
Sautéed pork or chicken chunks with onion in a lemon wine sauce, or men's style (traditional) with onion in olive oil, wine and lemon. Gluten free
Assortment: 1 souvlaki, 1 seasoned beef patty, 1 lamb chop, gyro, tzatziki and pita
